title.zh: 卷414 列傳二百一 李臣典 萧孚泗 朱洪章 刘连捷 彭毓橘 张诗日 伍维寿 朱南桂 罗逢元 李祥和 萧庆衍 吴宗国
title.en: Volume 414 Biographies 201: Li Chendian, Xiao Fusi, Zhu Hongzhang, Liu Lianjie, Peng Yuju, Zhang Shiri, Wu Weishou, Zhu Nangui, Luo Fengyuan, Li Xianghe, Xiao Qingyan, Wu Zongguo
title.raw: 卷414 列傳二百一 李臣典 萧孚泗 朱洪章 刘连捷 彭毓橘 张诗日 伍维寿 朱南桂 罗逢元 李祥和 萧庆衍 吴宗国

sentences.zh: =李臣典=李臣典，字祥雲，湖南邵陽人。

translations.literal: =Li Chendian= Li Chendian, styled Xiangyun, was a native of Shaoyang in Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: =Li Chendian= Li Chendian, whose style was Xiangyun, came from Shaoyang in Hunan.

sentences.zh: 年十八從軍，初隸王珍部下，後從曾國荃援江西，隸吉字營。

translations.literal: At eighteen he entered the army, first serving under Wang Zhen, later following Zeng Guoquan to relieve Jiangxi and joining the Jizi Battalion.
translations.idiomatic: He joined the army at eighteen, first under Wang Zhen, then with Zeng Guoquan’s relief force in Jiangxi, where he was assigned to the Jizi Battalion.

sentences.zh: 咸豐八年，戰吉安南門外，國荃受重創，臣典大呼挺矛進，追殺至永豐、新淦。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Xianfeng, fighting outside Ji’an’s south gate, Guoquan suffered grave wounds; Chendian shouted and advanced with spear levelled, pursuing and killing as far as Yongfeng and Xin’gan.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of Xianfeng, at the battle outside Ji’an’s south gate, Guoquan was badly wounded; Chendian charged forward spear in hand with a great shout and drove the pursuit all the way to Yongfeng and Xin’gan.

sentences.zh: 國荃奇其勇，超擢寶慶營守備。

translations.literal: Guoquan marveled at his bravery and exceptionally promoted him to garrison commander of the Baqing Battalion.
translations.idiomatic: Impressed by his courage, Guoquan skipped the usual steps and made him garrison commander of the Baqing Battalion.

sentences.zh: 克景德鎮，复浮梁，皆為軍鋒。

translations.literal: In the capture of Jingdezhen and recovery of Fuliang, he each time led the army’s vanguard.
translations.idiomatic: When Jingdezhen was taken and Fuliang recovered, he led the vanguard on both occasions.

sentences.zh: 十年，從戰小池驛，晉都司，賜花翎。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he fought at Xiaochi Post Station, was promoted to company commander, and was granted the peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he fought at Xiaochi Post Station, rose to company commander, and received the peacock feather insignia.

sentences.zh: 進規安慶，戰菱湖，逼賊屯，扼其北，國荃傷股墜馬，臣典馳救以歸。

translations.literal: Advancing to besiege Anqing, he fought at Linghu, pressed the rebel encampment, and held its north; Guoquan was wounded in the thigh and fell from his horse, and Chendian galloped to rescue him and brought him back.
translations.idiomatic: During the advance on Anqing he fought at Linghu, pressed the rebel camp, and sealed off its northern side; when Guoquan was wounded in the thigh and thrown from his horse, Chendian rode to his rescue and carried him back.

sentences.zh: 偕張勝祿、張詩日戰樅陽，破援賊，水師得以進屯。

translations.literal: Together with Zhang Shenglu and Zhang Shiri he fought at Zongyang, defeated the relief rebels, and the naval force was thereby able to advance and encamp.
translations.idiomatic: Alongside Zhang Shenglu and Zhang Shiri he fought at Zongyang, broke the relieving rebel force, and cleared the way for the navy to move up and take position.

sentences.zh: 十一年，攻安慶西門賊壘，陳玉成糾楊輔清數万人圍官軍數重，戰至日中未決，馳告諸將曰：「事急矣，成敗在此舉！」

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, attacking the rebel fort at Anqing’s west gate, Chen Yucheng gathered Yang Fuqing and tens of thousands of men to surround the government troops in several rings; battle continued until noon without decision. He galloped to inform the generals, saying: “The matter is urgent! Success or failure hangs on this effort!”
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year, while assaulting the rebel bastion at Anqing’s west gate, Chen Yucheng mustered Yang Fuqing and tens of thousands of men and wrapped the imperial forces in layer after layer of encirclement; the fight raged until noon with no outcome. Chendian rode to the generals and cried, “This is desperate—everything depends on what we do now!”

sentences.zh: 臣典橫槊前驅，與諸營合力決盪，賊大奔，斬首數千級，遂拔安慶，擢參將，賜號剛勇巴圖魯。

translations.literal: Chendian spear across body led the van; with the various camps he joined in a decisive charge, the rebels fled in great disorder, and heads cut numbered several thousand. Thereupon Anqing was taken; he was promoted to deputy commander and granted the title Gangyong Batulu.
translations.idiomatic: He charged at the head with spear levelled; the camps together delivered one crushing blow, the rebels broke and ran, and several thousand heads were taken. Anqing fell, Chendian was made deputy commander, and he received the title Gangyong Batulu.

sentences.zh: 同治元年，從國荃乘勝下沿江各城隘，進軍江寧，臣典會取丹陽鎮，奪秣陵關，以總兵記名。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tongzhi, following Guoquan in pressing the advantage down the Yangtze’s fortified towns and passes and advancing on Jiangning, Chendian jointly took Zhenjiang and seized Moling Pass, and was recorded by name as a regional commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tongzhi he followed Guoquan’s victorious drive along the Yangtze strongholds toward Jiangning, helped capture Zhenjiang, and took Moling Pass, earning nomination as regional commander.

sentences.zh: 軍中疫作，李秀成大舉來援，逼壘鏖戰，國荃督陣，砲傷頰，臣典與副將倪桂節力衛之，桂節陣亡。

translations.literal: Plague broke out in the army; Li Xiucheng came in force to relieve the city and pressed the fort in fierce battle. Guoquan directed the line, was wounded in the cheek by artillery, and Chendian with deputy commander Ni Guijie strenuously defended him; Guijie died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: When plague swept the army, Li Xiucheng marched up in strength; the rebels pressed the encampment in bitter fighting. Guoquan commanded from the front and took a shell wound to the cheek; Chendian and Deputy Commander Ni Guijie fought hard to shield him, and Guijie fell on the field.

sentences.zh: 賊方攻西路急，臣典曰：「此虛聲也，請備東路。」

translations.literal: The rebels were pressing hard on the west road; Chendian said: “This is a feint—please prepare the east road.”
translations.idiomatic: The rebels were hammering the western approach; Chendian said, “That is a diversion—hold the east road ready.”

sentences.zh: 既而賊果萃東路，參將劉玉春死之。

translations.literal: Before long the rebels indeed massed on the east road, and deputy commander Liu Yuchun died there.
translations.idiomatic: Sure enough the rebels soon massed on the east, where Deputy Commander Liu Yuchun was killed.

sentences.zh: 砲彈穿壁牆如雨注，臣典死守，卒不能入。

translations.literal: Shells pierced the walls like driving rain; Chendian held to the death, and in the end they could not enter.
translations.idiomatic: Shot tore through the walls like rain; Chendian held the line at all costs, and the rebels never broke through.

sentences.zh: 圍解，加提督銜。

translations.literal: When the siege was lifted, he was given the brevet rank of provincial commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: After the siege was raised, he received the brevet title of provincial commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 二年，偕趙三元夜襲雨花台石城，束草填壕，緣梯將上，賊驚覺，燃砲轟擊，軍少卻。

translations.literal: In the second year, together with Zhao Sanyuan he made a night assault on the stone fort at Yuhuatai, bundling straw to fill the moat and climbing ladders to scale the wall; the rebels were roused, fired cannon in bombardment, and the army briefly fell back.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he and Zhao Sanyuan raided the Yuhuatai stone fort by night, stuffing the ditch with straw bundles and going up on ladders; the rebels woke, opened fire with cannon, and the troops briefly withdrew.

sentences.zh: 臣典搴旗大呼躍而上，諸軍繼之，擲火彈毀敵樓，城立拔，以提督記名。

translations.literal: Chendian seized the standard, shouted, and leaped up; the armies followed, hurled fire bombs and destroyed the enemy tower, and the fort was taken at once; he was recorded by name as provincial commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Chendian snatched the banner, shouted, and vaulted the wall; the rest poured after him, threw fire bombs that wrecked the enemy tower, and the fort fell at once; he was nominated provincial commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 尋授河南歸德鎮總兵。

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter he was appointed regional commander of Guide Garrison in Henan.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon appointed regional commander of the Guide garrison in Henan.

sentences.zh: 偕蕭孚泗、張詩日等攻奪紫金山，又敗諸校場，連克近城諸壘。

translations.literal: Together with Xiao Fusi, Zhang Shiri, and others he attacked and seized Purple Mountain, again defeated the rebels at the drill grounds, and in succession took the forts near the city.
translations.idiomatic: With Xiao Fusi, Zhang Shiri, and others he stormed Purple Mountain, routed the rebels at the drill grounds, and in succession reduced the outworks around the city.

sentences.zh: 三年，克天保城，江寧之圍始合。

translations.literal: In the third year Tianbao Fort was taken and the encirclement of Jiangning was at last closed.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year Tianbao Fort fell and the ring around Jiangning finally closed.

sentences.zh: 五月，克地保城。

translations.literal: In the fifth month Dibao Fort was taken.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Dibao Fort was captured.

sentences.zh: 六月，諸軍番休進攻，賊死拒，殺傷相當。

translations.literal: In the sixth month the armies attacked in rotation by shifts; the rebels resisted to the death, and casualties on both sides were about equal.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month the armies attacked in relays; the rebels fought to the last, and losses on both sides were heavy and roughly matched.

sentences.zh: 臣典偵知賊糧未盡，諸軍苦戰力漸疲，謂國荃曰：「師老矣！

translations.literal: Chendian learned by reconnaissance that the rebels’ grain was not yet exhausted and that the armies, fighting bitterly, were growing weary; he said to Guoquan: “The army is worn!
translations.idiomatic: Chendian’s scouts reported that the rebels still had grain in store while the troops, worn down by hard fighting, were flagging; he told Guoquan, “Our men are exhausted!

sentences.zh: 不急克，日久且生變。

translations.literal: If we do not take it quickly, in time something untoward will arise.
translations.idiomatic: Unless we take the city soon, delay will breed trouble.

sentences.zh: 請於龍膊子重掘地道，原獨任之。」

translations.literal: I ask to reopen a tunnel at Longbozi and take sole responsibility for it.”
translations.idiomatic: Let me reopen the tunnel at Longbozi and bear the task alone.”

sentences.zh: 遂率副將吳宗國等日夜穴城，十五日地道成，臣典與九將同列誓狀。

translations.literal: Thereupon he led deputy commander Wu Zongguo and others day and night in mining under the wall; on the fifteenth day the tunnel was complete, and Chendian with nine generals jointly submitted a sworn pledge.
translations.idiomatic: He then led Deputy Commander Wu Zongguo and others in round-the-clock mining; on the fifteenth day the tunnel was ready, and Chendian and nine generals signed a joint oath on military orders.

sentences.zh: 翼日，地雷發，臣典等蟻附入城，諸軍畢入。

translations.literal: The next day the land mine was fired; Chendian and others swarmed into the city like ants, and all the armies entered.
translations.idiomatic: The next day the mine blew; Chendian and his men poured through the breach like ants, and the whole army followed in.

sentences.zh: 下令見長發者、新薙發者皆殺，於是殺賊十餘萬人。

translations.literal: An order was issued that whoever had long hair or freshly shaven hair should be killed; thus more than a hundred thousand rebels were slain.
translations.idiomatic: Orders went out to kill anyone with long hair or a fresh shave—the marks of Taiping affiliation—and more than a hundred thousand rebels were put to the sword.

sentences.zh: 臣典遽病，恃壯不休息，未幾，卒於軍，年二十七。

translations.literal: Chendian suddenly fell ill; relying on his strength he would not rest, and before long he died in camp at the age of twenty-seven.
translations.idiomatic: Chendian fell suddenly ill; confident in his strength, he refused to rest, and soon died in camp at twenty-seven.

sentences.zh: 捷上，列臣典功第一，錫封一等子爵，賜黃馬褂、雙眼花翎。

translations.literal: When the victory report went up, Chendian’s merit was ranked first; he was enfeoffed as a first-rank viscount, and granted the yellow riding jacket and double-eyed peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: In the victory memorial Chendian’s service was placed first; he was enfeoffed as a first-class viscount and granted the yellow jacket and double-eyed peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 命未至而臣典已歿，詔加贈太子少保，諡忠壯，吉安、安慶、江寧各建專祠。

translations.literal: The decree had not arrived when Chendian was already dead; an edict posthumously added Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, gave the posthumous name Zhongzhuang, and ordered separate shrines built at Ji’an, Anqing, and Jiangning.
translations.idiomatic: The order reached him only after his death; the court posthumously made him Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, gave him the posthumous name Zhongzhuang, and built him a dedicated shrine at Ji’an, Anqing, and Jiangning.

sentences.zh: =蕭孚泗=蕭孚泗，湖南湘鄉人。

translations.literal: =Xiao Fusi= Xiao Fusi was a native of Xiangxiang in Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: =Xiao Fusi= Xiao Fusi came from Xiangxiang in Hunan.

sentences.zh: 咸豐三年，入湘軍，從羅澤南轉戰江西、湖北，洊擢守備。

translations.literal: In the third year of Xianfeng he entered the Hunan Army, followed Luo Zinan in campaigns through Jiangxi and Hubei, and was repeatedly promoted to garrison commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Xianfeng he joined the Hunan Army, campaigned with Luo Zinan through Jiangxi and Hubei, and rose by repeated steps to garrison commander.

sentences.zh: 六年，從曾國荃援江西，克安福、吉水、萬安諸縣。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he followed Zeng Guoquan to relieve Jiangxi and took the counties of Anfu, Jishui, and Wan’an.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he followed Guoquan’s relief of Jiangxi and helped capture Anfu, Jishui, and Wan’an.

sentences.zh: 七年，克峽江，擢游擊，賜花翎。

translations.literal: In the seventh year Xiájiang was taken; he was promoted to battalion commander and granted the peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year Xiájiang fell; he was made battalion commander and given the peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 八年，從攻吉安，賊出撲孚泗營，開壁奮擊，斃悍賊多名。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, in the attack on Ji’an, rebels sallied against Fusi’s camp; he opened the ramparts and struck fiercely, killing many fierce rebels.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, during the siege of Ji’an, rebels rushed Fusi’s camp; he threw open the walls and counterattacked, killing many of their toughest fighters.

sentences.zh: 旋克吉安，擢參將。

translations.literal: Ji’an was soon taken, and he was promoted to deputy commander.
translations.idiomatic: Ji’an fell soon after, and he was promoted to deputy commander.

sentences.zh: 九年，江西肅清，擢副將。

translations.literal: In the ninth year Jiangxi was pacified, and he was promoted to brigade commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, with Jiangxi cleared, he was made brigade commander.

sentences.zh: 會攻太湖，十年春，大戰小池驛，复太湖，孚泗功多，賜號勷勇巴圖魯。

translations.literal: He joined the attack on Taihu; in the spring of the tenth year there was a great battle at Xiaochi Post Station, Taihu was recovered, Fusi’s merit was great, and he was granted the title Xiangyong Batulu.
translations.idiomatic: He took part in the Taihu campaign; in the spring of the tenth year the great fight at Xiaochi Post Station ended with Taihu recovered; Fusi’s service stood out, and he received the title Xiangyong Batulu.

sentences.zh: 進攻安慶，戰菱湖，孚泗於東路橫壕倚水築新營，會擊屢破賊。

translations.literal: Advancing to attack Anqing, he fought at Linghu; on the east road Fusi dug a transverse trench, built a new camp leaning on the water, and in joint attacks repeatedly defeated the rebels.
translations.idiomatic: In the advance on Anqing he fought at Linghu; on the eastern front Fusi cut a trench across the line, threw up a new camp along the water, and in combined strikes repeatedly broke the rebels.

sentences.zh: 分道攻安慶城外諸壘，賊援迭至，與城賊相應，更番撲官軍營壘，孚泗等且戰且築壘，賊不得逞；

translations.literal: They attacked in separate columns the forts outside Anqing’s walls; rebel relief came in succession and coordinated with the city rebels, taking turns in assaulting the government camps; Fusi and others fought while building forts, and the rebels could not prevail;
translations.idiomatic: They assaulted the outworks around Anqing in separate columns; rebel reinforcements kept arriving and coordinated with the garrison, rotating assaults on the imperial camps; Fusi and his men fought while entrenching, and the rebels could not break through;

sentences.zh: 又偕水師副將蔡國祥截獲賊糧。

translations.literal: he also together with naval deputy commander Cai Guoxiang intercepted rebel grain supplies.
translations.idiomatic: he also worked with Naval Deputy Commander Cai Guoxiang to intercept rebel grain convoys.

sentences.zh: 八月，以地雷壞城，復安慶，以總兵記名。

translations.literal: In the eighth month a land mine breached the wall, Anqing was recovered, and he was recorded by name as regional commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month a mine brought down the wall, Anqing was retaken, and he was nominated regional commander.

sentences.zh: 加提督銜，授河南歸德鎮總兵。

translations.literal: He was given the brevet rank of provincial commander-in-chief and appointed regional commander of Guide Garrison in Henan.
translations.idiomatic: He received the brevet title of provincial commander-in-chief and was appointed regional commander of the Guide garrison in Henan.

sentences.zh: 同治元年，國荃循江東下，孚泗為前鋒，攻拔西梁山。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tongzhi, Guoquan advanced down the river; Fusi was vanguard and attacked and took West Liang Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tongzhi, as Guoquan drove down the Yangtze, Fusi led the van and stormed West Liang Mountain.

sentences.zh: 會水師克太平、蕪湖，破金柱關、東梁山，進克秣陵關、江心洲，乘勝逼江寧，以提督記名。

translations.literal: The naval force took Taiping and Wuhu, broke Jingzhu Pass and East Liang Mountain, advanced to take Moling Pass and Jiangxin Isle, pressed the advantage against Jiangning, and he was recorded by name as provincial commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: The navy captured Taiping and Wuhu, broke Jingzhu Pass and East Liang Mountain, then took Moling Pass and Jiangxin Isle; riding the momentum they pressed Jiangning, and Fusi was nominated provincial commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 李秀成來援，分黨趨江心洲截運道，孚泗等逆擊敗之。

translations.literal: Li Xiucheng came to relieve the city; detachments moved toward Jiangxin Isle to cut the supply route, and Fusi and others met them in counterattack and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Li Xiucheng marched to the rescue; rebel columns moved on Jiangxin Isle to sever the supply line, and Fusi counterattacked and drove them off.

sentences.zh: 賊攻孚泗後營砲台，相持十餘日，賊以地雷毀營牆，孚泗以火藥數十桶擲轟，賊不得入。

translations.literal: Rebels attacked the artillery platform at Fusi’s rear camp; the standoff lasted more than ten days; rebels used a land mine to destroy the camp wall; Fusi hurled dozens of barrels of gunpowder in bombardment, and the rebels could not enter.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels assaulted the gun platform at Fusi’s rear camp; the fight dragged on for more than ten days until a mine blew in the wall; Fusi hurled dozens of powder kegs into the breach and kept the rebels out.

sentences.zh: 伺賊疲，孚泗與彭毓橘突出夾擊，踏平賊壘數十，賜黃馬褂。

translations.literal: Watching for rebel fatigue, Fusi with Peng Yuju sallied forth in pincer attack and leveled several tens of rebel forts; he was granted the yellow riding jacket.
translations.idiomatic: When the rebels tired, Fusi and Peng Yuju burst out in a pincer and flattened dozens of rebel works; he was granted the yellow jacket.

sentences.zh: 二年，偕總兵李臣典襲克雨花台石城，追至上方橋，斬馘數千，又破秣陵關賊卡。

translations.literal: In the second year, together with regional commander Li Chendian he stormed and took the Yuhuatai stone fort, pursued to Shangfang Bridge, and killed and decapitated several thousand; he also broke the rebel stockade at Moling Pass.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he and Regional Commander Li Chendian seized the Yuhuatai stone fort by surprise, pursued to Shangfang Bridge with thousands of kills, and smashed the rebel post at Moling Pass.

sentences.zh: 夜襲上方橋，結筏渡河，扼雙橋門，連破賊隘。

translations.literal: He made a night raid on Shangfang Bridge, lashed rafts to cross the river, held Shuangqiao Gate, and in succession broke rebel passes.
translations.idiomatic: He raided Shangfang Bridge by night, rafted the river, seized Shuangqiao Gate, and in succession cleared the rebel barricades.

sentences.zh: 偕彭毓橘縱火焚其橋，襲賊屯，擢福建陸軍提督。

translations.literal: Together with Peng Yuju he set fire and burned their bridge, raided the rebel encampment, and was promoted to Fujian Army provincial commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: With Peng Yuju he burned the bridge by fire, stormed the rebel camp, and was made provincial commander-in-chief of the Fujian Army.

sentences.zh: 三年，既克天保城，孚泗出鍾山北，於太平門築三壘守之，絕賊糧道。

translations.literal: In the third year, after Tianbao Fort was taken, Fusi went out north of Zhong Mountain, built three forts at Taiping Gate to hold them, and cut off the rebels’ grain route.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, once Tianbao Fort had fallen, Fusi moved north of Zhong Mountain, threw up three forts at Taiping Gate, and severed the rebels’ supply line.

sentences.zh: 六月，進占龍膊子山石城，孚泗與李臣典築砲台山上，距城僅十餘丈，積沙草高與城齊，作偽攻狀，潛於其下鑿地道。

translations.literal: In the sixth month they advanced and occupied the stone fort at Longbozi Mountain; Fusi and Li Chendian built artillery platforms on the hill, only a dozen-odd zhang from the wall, heaped sand and straw as high as the wall to feign assault, and secretly mined a tunnel beneath.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month they took the Longbozi stone fort; Fusi and Li Chendian raised gun platforms on the slope barely a dozen yards from the wall, piled sand and straw to wall height as a feint, and dug a tunnel underneath in secret.

sentences.zh: 賊宵攻毀砲台，副將陳萬勝戰死，明日，會師逼城下，總兵郭鵬程、王紹羲復中砲死。

translations.literal: Rebels attacked by night and destroyed the artillery platform; deputy commander Chen Wansheng died in battle. The next day the united armies pressed under the wall; regional commanders Guo Pengcheng and Wang Shaoyi were again killed by artillery.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels struck at night and wrecked the gun platform; Deputy Commander Chen Wansheng fell. Next day the combined force pressed the wall; Regional Commanders Guo Pengcheng and Wang Shaoyi were killed by shellfire in turn.

sentences.zh: 及地道成，火發城圮，將士爭登，賊擲火藥抵拒，死僕相繼。

translations.literal: When the tunnel was complete, fire was set, the wall collapsed, and officers and soldiers scrambled to scale; the rebels hurled gunpowder to resist, and the dead fell one after another.
translations.idiomatic: When the tunnel was ready the charge blew the wall down; men scrambled up the breach while rebels hurled powder in their faces, and the fallen piled up in succession.

sentences.zh: 孚泗手刃退者數人，士氣乃奮，盡從缺口入。

translations.literal: Fusi personally killed several who fell back, morale then surged, and all entered through the breach.
translations.idiomatic: Fusi himself cut down several men who wavered; morale rallied, and the troops poured through the breach.

sentences.zh: 李秀成匿民舍，孚泗索獲之，並擒洪仁達。

translations.literal: Li Xiucheng hid in a civilian house; Fusi searched him out and captured him, and also seized Hong Rendeng.
translations.idiomatic: Li Xiucheng hid in a private house; Fusi tracked him down and took him, along with Hong Rendeng.

sentences.zh: 論功，賜封一等男爵，賜雙眼花翎。

translations.literal: In reckoning merit he was enfeoffed as a first-rank baron and granted the double-eyed peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: For his service he was enfeoffed as a first-class baron and given the double-eyed peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 尋丁父憂歸。

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter he went home on mourning for his father’s death.
translations.idiomatic: He soon left for home to observe mourning for his father.

sentences.zh: 光緒十年，卒於家，優恤，諡壯肅。

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Guangxu he died at home; generous condolence gifts were granted, and the posthumous name Zhuangsu was given.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year of Guangxu he died at home; the court granted generous posthumous honors and the name Zhuangsu.

sentences.zh: =朱洪章=朱洪章，字煥文，貴州黎平人。

translations.literal: =Zhu Hongzhang= Zhu Hongzhang, styled Huanwen, was a native of Liping in Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: =Zhu Hongzhang= Zhu Hongzhang, whose style was Huanwen, came from Liping in Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 咸豐初，應募為鄉勇，從黎平知府胡林翼剿新寧竄匪，又剿黃平榔匪，擒匪首劉瞎麼，以功獎外委。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Xianfeng he enlisted as local militia, followed Liping prefect Hu Linyi in suppressing bandits who had fled into Xinning, and again suppressed the Lang bandits of Huangping, capturing the bandit chief Liu Xiamo; for merit he was rewarded with the rank of externe corporal.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Xianfeng he joined the local militia, followed Prefect Hu Linyi of Liping against bandits driven into Xinning, then against the Lang bandits of Huangping, capturing their leader Liu Xiamo and earning the rank of externe corporal.

sentences.zh: 四年，從林翼援湖北，會克岳州。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he followed Linyi to relieve Hubei and jointly took Yuezhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he marched with Linyi to relieve Hubei and helped take Yuezhou.

sentences.zh: 從塔齊布攻武昌，破賊洪山，遂隸塔齊布軍。

translations.literal: He followed Taaqibu in the attack on Wuchang, defeated the rebels at Hongshan, and thereupon was attached to Taaqibu’s army.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Taaqibu against Wuchang, routed the rebels at Hongshan, and entered Taaqibu’s command.

sentences.zh: 戰大冶、半壁山、田家鎮、孔壟、小池口，攻九江，無役不從，以勇名。

translations.literal: He fought at Daye, Banbishan, Tianjiazhen, Konglong, and Xiaochikou, and attacked Jiujiang; in no campaign did he fail to follow, and he was famed for bravery.
translations.idiomatic: He fought at Daye, Banbishan, Tianjiazhen, Konglong, and Xiaochikou and joined the assault on Jiujiang; he was in every fight and won a name for courage.

sentences.zh: 塔齊布卒，從周鳳山。

translations.literal: When Taaqibu died, he followed Zhou Fengshan.
translations.idiomatic: After Taaqibu’s death he served under Zhou Fengshan.

sentences.zh: 鳳山敗，隸畢金科。

translations.literal: When Fengshan was defeated, he was attached to Bi Jinke.
translations.idiomatic: When Fengshan was beaten, he passed to Bi Jinke’s command.

sentences.zh: 六年，克饒州，擢千總。

translations.literal: In the sixth year Raozhou was taken, and he was promoted to platoon leader.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year Raozhou fell and he was made platoon leader.

sentences.zh: 金科戰歿，代領其軍。

translations.literal: Jinke died in battle, and he took command of his army in his stead.
translations.idiomatic: When Jinke fell in battle, Hongzhang took over his troops.

sentences.zh: 江西不給餉，張芾倚蔽皖南，資之，軍始不散。

translations.literal: Jiangxi did not provide pay; Zhang Fei, relying on his screen in southern Anhui, supplied funds, and only then did the army not disperse.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangxi paid no rations; Zhang Fei, shielded in southern Anhui, supplied the funds that kept the army from breaking up.

sentences.zh: 又以會攻四十里街，他將敗績，被劾，降把總。

translations.literal: Also because in the joint attack on Sishili Street other generals suffered defeat, he was impeached and demoted to corporal.
translations.idiomatic: He was also impeached and demoted to corporal after a joint assault on Sishili Street ended in defeat for the other commanders.

sentences.zh: 九年，從曾國荃复景德鎮，复官，以守備補用。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he followed Zeng Guoquan in recovering Jingdezhen, was restored to office, and was appointed to fill a garrison commander vacancy.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he followed Guoquan in retaking Jingdezhen, regained his rank, and was posted as garrison commander.

sentences.zh: 遂從曾國荃部下，戰績始著。

translations.literal: Thereupon he served under Zeng Guoquan, and his battle achievements first became notable.
translations.idiomatic: He then served under Guoquan, and his record in battle first came to notice.

sentences.zh: 十年，從攻太湖，解小池驛之圍，晉都司。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he joined the attack on Taihu, relieved the siege at Xiaochi Post Station, and was promoted to company commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he joined the Taihu campaign, lifted the siege at Xiaochi Post Station, and was made company commander.

sentences.zh: 進攻安慶，爭壕奪壘，斬刈甚多。

translations.literal: Advancing to attack Anqing, he contested trenches and seized forts, and killed and mowed down many.
translations.idiomatic: In the advance on Anqing he fought for trenches and forts and cut down great numbers of the enemy.

sentences.zh: 十一年，克安慶，超擢參將，賜號勤勇巴圖魯。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year Anqing was taken; he was exceptionally promoted to deputy commander and granted the title Qinyong Batulu.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year Anqing fell; he was jumped to deputy commander and given the title Qinyong Batulu.

sentences.zh: 從國荃由皖東下，連奪沿江要隘，擢副將。

translations.literal: Following Guoquan eastward from Anhui down the river, he in succession seized key passes along the Yangtze and was promoted to brigade commander.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Guoquan’s drive east from Anhui down the Yangtze, taking one strategic pass after another, and was made brigade commander.

sentences.zh: 進屯雨花台，江寧城賊出撲，屢擊破之。

translations.literal: Advancing to encamp at Yuhuatai, when Jiangning’s city rebels sallied forth he repeatedly defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: He advanced to camp at Yuhuatai and repeatedly beat back the sorties from Jiangning.

sentences.zh: 及援賊至，大營被圍，迭以地雷毀營牆，悍賊擁入，口銜利刃，匍匐而進。

translations.literal: When relief rebels arrived the main camp was surrounded; repeatedly land mines destroyed the camp walls; fierce rebels pressed in, blades in their mouths, crawling forward.
translations.idiomatic: When rebel reinforcements came the main camp was encircled; mines blew gap after gap in the walls; the toughest rebels poured in with blades clenched between their teeth, crawling forward.

sentences.zh: 洪章督隊發槍砲，擲火焚燒，斃賊無算，傷亡士卒甚多，久之始解。

translations.literal: Hongzhang directed his companies in firing muskets and cannon, hurling fire in burning attack; rebels killed were beyond counting, government soldiers wounded and killed were also very many; only after a long time was the siege lifted.
translations.idiomatic: Hongzhang led his men in musket and cannon fire and fire-bomb attacks, killing rebels beyond count at the cost of heavy government casualties; only after a long ordeal was the siege broken.

sentences.zh: 洪章先以迭克城隘，以總兵記名，至是加提督銜。

translations.literal: Hongzhang had earlier, through repeatedly taking city passes, been recorded by name as regional commander; at this time the brevet rank of provincial commander-in-chief was added.
translations.idiomatic: Hongzhang had already been nominated regional commander for repeatedly taking city outworks; now he received the brevet title of provincial commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 同治三年，攻江寧久不拔，及開地道於龍膊子山麓告成，議推前鋒。

translations.literal: In the third year of Tongzhi, the attack on Jiangning long failed to succeed; when the tunnel opened at the foot of Longbozi Mountain was completed, they deliberated on who should lead the vanguard.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Tongzhi the siege of Jiangning had dragged on without success; when the tunnel at the foot of Longbozi Mountain was finished, the commanders debated who should lead the assault.

sentences.zh: 國荃召諸將署名具軍令狀，洪章署第一，武明良第二，劉連捷第三，其他以次署畢，共得九人。

translations.literal: Guoquan summoned the generals to sign and submit military pledges; Hongzhang signed first, Wu Mingliang second, Liu Lianjie third, and the others signed in order until nine men in all were obtained.
translations.idiomatic: Guoquan called the generals to sign written military oaths; Hongzhang signed first, Wu Mingliang second, Liu Lianjie third, and the rest in order until nine names were on the list.

sentences.zh: 發火城崩，洪章率所部長、勝、煥字三營千五百人，從倒口首先沖入，賊倉猝從城頭擲火藥傾盆下，士卒死四百餘人。

translations.literal: Fire was set, the wall collapsed; Hongzhang led fifteen hundred men of his Chang, Sheng, and Huanzi battalions and from the breach rushed in first; rebels in haste from the wall top hurled gunpowder down like pouring from a basin, and more than four hundred soldiers died.
translations.idiomatic: The mine blew and the wall fell; Hongzhang led fifteen hundred men of his Chang, Sheng, and Huanzi battalions through the breach at the head of the assault; rebels on the wall hurled powder down in sheets, and more than four hundred of his men were killed.

sentences.zh: 洪章入城後，結圜陣與賊排擊。

translations.literal: After Hongzhang entered the city he formed a circular formation and engaged the rebels in rank fighting.
translations.idiomatic: Once inside the city Hongzhang formed a ring formation and fought the rebels rank to rank.

sentences.zh: 諸將畢入，乃分軍為三，洪章趨中路，直攻天王府之北，短兵巷戰一日夜，搜斬逆酋尤眾，賜黃馬褂，予騎都尉世職，無論提鎮缺出，侭先題奏。

translations.literal: When all the generals had entered, the army was divided into three; Hongzhang pressed the center route, attacking straight north of the Heavenly King’s Palace; close combat in the lanes lasted a day and a night; in searching out and beheading rebel chiefs he was especially numerous; he was granted the yellow riding jacket, given the hereditary office of Cavalry Commandant, and whenever provincial commander or regional commander vacancies arose he was to be memorialized first.
translations.idiomatic: After all the generals were inside the force split three ways; Hongzhang took the center and drove straight on the north side of the Heavenly King’s Palace; hand-to-hand fighting in the lanes lasted a full day and night, and he killed more rebel leaders than any other; he received the yellow jacket, a hereditary Cavalry Commandant title, and priority nomination whenever a provincial or regional command opened.

sentences.zh: 初敘入城功，李臣典以決策居第一，洪章列第三，眾為不平。

translations.literal: When the merit for entering the city was first recounted, Li Chendian was ranked first for decision-making, Hongzhang third, and many felt this unjust.
translations.idiomatic: In the first reckoning of merit for taking the city, Li Chendian was placed first for the tunnel plan and Hongzhang third; many thought that unfair.

sentences.zh: 洪章曰：「吾一介武夫，由行伍擢至總鎮。

translations.literal: Hongzhang said: “I am but a single fighting man, raised from the ranks to regional commander.
translations.idiomatic: Hongzhang said, “I am only a fighting man promoted from the ranks to regional commander.

sentences.zh: 今幸東南底定，百戰餘生，荷天寵錫，已叨非分，又何求焉？」

translations.literal: Now fortunately the southeast is settled; surviving a hundred battles, I have received Heaven’s favor and grace—already more than my due—what more could I seek?”
translations.idiomatic: Now that the southeast is at peace and I have survived a hundred fights, Heaven’s favor has already given me more than I deserve—what more could I ask?”

sentences.zh: 四年，授湖南永州鎮總兵。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he was appointed regional commander of Yongzhou Garrison in Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he was appointed regional commander of the Yongzhou garrison in Hunan.

sentences.zh: 光緒二年，調雲南鶴麗鎮，署昭通、臨安、騰越諸鎮。

translations.literal: In the second year of Guangxu he was transferred to Heli Garrison in Yunnan and acted as commander of Zhaotong, Lin’an, and Tengyue garrisons.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Guangxu he was transferred to the Heli garrison in Yunnan and served in turn as acting commander at Zhaotong, Lin’an, and Tengyue.

sentences.zh: 鶴麗地卑下，水潦常沒民田，有新河洩水，通塞無常。

translations.literal: Heli’s land is low-lying; floods often inundate the people’s fields; there is a New River for drainage, but whether it is open or blocked is irregular.
translations.idiomatic: Heli lies low, and floods often drowned the people’s fields; a New River was meant to drain the water, but it silted up or ran free without pattern.

sentences.zh: 洪章在鎮，躬率士卒開濬數次，水患為紓，民感之。

translations.literal: While Hongzhang was at the garrison he personally led soldiers in dredging several times; the water disaster was eased, and the people were grateful.
translations.idiomatic: At his post Hongzhang personally led troops in dredging again and again; the floods eased, and the people were grateful.

sentences.zh: 十四年，因病乞開缺，病痊，曾國荃調留兩江，洪章憑弔龍膊子山，祭死士瘞所，國荃為樹碑紀事。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year, ill, he requested to be relieved of office; when recovered, Zeng Guoquan summoned him to remain in the Two Jiangs; Hongzhang went to Longbozi Mountain to mourn, sacrificed at the burial place of the dead soldiers, and Guoquan erected a stele to record the event.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year he asked to resign on grounds of illness; when he recovered, Guoquan kept him in the Two Jiangs region; Hongzhang went to Longbozi Mountain to mourn the dead, offered sacrifice at their burial ground, and Guoquan set up a stele to commemorate it.

sentences.zh: 十五年，署狼山鎮總兵。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year he acted as regional commander of Langshan Garrison.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year he served as acting regional commander of the Langshan garrison.

sentences.zh: 二十年，張之洞檄募十營防金沙衛。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year Zhang Zhidong issued an order to raise ten battalions to defend Jinshawei.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year Zhang Zhidong ordered him to raise ten battalions to garrison Jinshawei.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，卒於軍。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year he died in camp.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year he died on active service.

sentences.zh: 之洞疏陳戰績，稱其收復江寧，功實第一。

translations.literal: Zhidong in a memorial reported his battle achievements, saying that in recovering Jiangning his merit was truly first.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Zhidong memorialized his record in battle and declared that in the recovery of Jiangning his service ranked first.

sentences.zh: 詔宣付史館，從優議卹，諡武慎，附祀曾國籓、國荃、胡林翼專祠。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the matter proclaimed and transmitted to the Historiographical Institute; generous condolence and posthumous honors were deliberated; the posthumous name Wushen was given; he was granted attached worship in the dedicated shrines of Zeng Guofan, Guoquan, and Hu Linyi.
translations.idiomatic: The throne ordered the report sent to the Historiographical Institute, directed generous posthumous honors, and gave him the name Wushen, with a place in the dedicated shrines of Zeng Guofan, Guoquan, and Hu Linyi.

sentences.zh: =劉連捷=劉連捷，字南雲，湖南湘鄉人。

translations.literal: =Liu Lianjie= Liu Lianjie, styled Nanyun, was a native of Xiangxiang in Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: =Liu Lianjie= Liu Lianjie, whose style was Nanyun, came from Xiangxiang in Hunan.

sentences.zh: 以外委隸同族劉騰鴻湘後營，轉戰湖北。

translations.literal: As an externe corporal he was attached to his clansman Liu Tenghong's Xiang Rear Battalion and campaigned in Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: He entered service as an externe corporal under his kinsman Liu Tenghong in the Xiang Rear Battalion and fought through Hubei.

sentences.zh: 羅澤南薦諸巡撫胡林翼，檄領副後營，擢千總。

translations.literal: Luo Zinan recommended him to governor Hu Linyi; he was ordered to command the deputy rear battalion and was promoted to platoon leader.
translations.idiomatic: Luo Zinan recommended him to Governor Hu Linyi, who ordered him to lead the deputy rear battalion and promoted him to platoon leader.

sentences.zh: 咸豐六年，從騰鴻援江西，戰瑞州，騰鴻中砲殞，連捷率所部攻城，拔之。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Xianfeng he followed Tenghong to relieve Jiangxi and fought at Ruizhou; Tenghong was killed by cannon; Lianjie led his command in storming the city and took it.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Xianfeng he marched with Tenghong into Jiangxi and fought at Ruizhou; when Tenghong was killed by cannon fire, Lianjie led his troops in storming the city and took it.

sentences.zh: 為曾國籓所重，薦改文職，以知縣留江西補用。

translations.literal: Valued by Zeng Guofan, he was recommended for transfer to civil office, to be appointed county magistrate when a vacancy arose in Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Guofan held him in high regard and recommended him for civil office, to be posted as county magistrate when a vacancy opened in Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 從曾國荃克吉安，擢同知，赴安徽助剿，十年，大捷於小池驛，擢知府。

translations.literal: Following Zeng Guoquan he took Ji'an, was promoted to subprefect, went to Anhui to assist in suppression; in the tenth year there was a great victory at Xiaochi Post Station, and he was promoted to prefect.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Guoquan in capturing Ji'an, was made subprefect, and went to Anhui to help suppress the rebels; in the tenth year he won a great victory at Xiaochi Post Station and was promoted to prefect.

sentences.zh: 由集賢關攻安慶，破援賊。

translations.literal: From Jixian Pass he attacked Anqing and defeated the relief rebels.
translations.idiomatic: Attacking Anqing from Jixian Pass, he routed the rebel relief force.

sentences.zh: 十一年，复破援賊於集賢關，克安慶，擢道員，賜號果勇巴圖魯。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he again defeated relief rebels at Jixian Pass, took Anqing, was promoted to circuit intendant, and was granted the title Guoyong Batulu.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he again broke the relief rebels at Jixian Pass, captured Anqing, was made circuit intendant, and received the title Guoyong Batulu.

sentences.zh: 同治元年，攻巢縣東關，賊立石牆於羅星山，連捷率死士夜渡河縱火燒賊營，進克西梁山、濡須口，渡江克太平府、金柱關、蕪湖，乘勝進軍江寧。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tongzhi he attacked Chaoxian's East Gate; the rebels built a stone wall on Luoxing Hill; Lianjie led death-defying soldiers by night to cross the river, set fire, and burn the rebel camp; he advanced to take Xiliang Hill and Ruxukou, crossed the river and took Taiping Prefecture, Jinzhu Pass, and Wuhu, and pressed the victory in an advance on Jiangning.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tongzhi he assaulted Chaoxian's East Gate, where the rebels had raised a stone wall on Luoxing Hill; Lianjie led a picked force across the river by night, burned the rebel camp, and pushed on to take Xiliang Hill and Ruxukou; crossing the Yangtze he captured Taiping, Jinzhu Pass, and Wuhu, then marched in triumph toward Jiangning.

sentences.zh: 連捷軍屯顏行，李秀成、李世賢糾大眾來攻，以炸砲破營壁，連捷築橫牆拒之，常乘賊懈夜出破賊壘。

translations.literal: Lianjie's army encamped at Yanxing; Li Xiucheng and Li Shixian gathered a large force to attack; explosive cannon broke the camp wall; Lianjie built a transverse wall to hold them off and often took advantage of rebel slackness to sally at night and break rebel forts.
translations.idiomatic: Lianjie's troops were at Yanxing when Li Xiucheng and Li Shixian mustered a huge force; shellfire breached the camp wall, but Lianjie threw up a cross-wall to hold the line and repeatedly exploited rebel lapses to raid their forts by night.

sentences.zh: 及賊退，以按察使記名，加布政使銜。

translations.literal: When the rebels withdrew, he was recorded by name as provincial surveillance commissioner and given the rank of provincial administration commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: After the rebels withdrew he was marked for promotion to provincial surveillance commissioner and given the rank of provincial administration commissioner.

sentences.zh: 大營恃無為州通餉道，連捷率三千人往守，營城外石澗阜。

translations.literal: The main camp relied on Wuwei Prefecture as a supply route; Lianjie led three thousand men to defend it and encamped on Shijian Hill outside the city walls.
translations.idiomatic: The main army depended on Wuwei Prefecture for its supply line, so Lianjie took three thousand men to hold it and pitched camp on Shijian Hill outside the walls.

sentences.zh: 二年，李秀成困以長圍，軍糧垂盡，彭玉麟勸突圍出，連捷誓死守。

translations.literal: In the second year Li Xiucheng besieged them with a long encirclement; army provisions were nearly exhausted; Peng Yulin urged breaking out, but Lianjie swore to defend to the death.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year Li Xiucheng tightened a long siege around them until provisions nearly ran out; Peng Yulin urged a breakout, but Lianjie vowed to hold to the last.

sentences.zh: 彭毓橘來援，合擊賊，走之，再复巢縣、含山、和州，賜黃馬褂。

translations.literal: Peng Yuju came to relieve them; jointly attacking the rebels they drove them off and again recovered Chaoxian, Hanshan, and Hezhou; he was granted a yellow riding jacket.
translations.idiomatic: Peng Yuju arrived with reinforcements; together they struck the rebels and drove them back, retaking Chaoxian, Hanshan, and Hezhou, and Lianjie was awarded a yellow riding jacket.

sentences.zh: 偕水師進攻九洑洲、下關。

translations.literal: Together with the naval force he advanced against Jiufuzhou and Xiaguan.
translations.idiomatic: He joined the river fleet in the assault on Jiufuzhou and Xiaguan.

sentences.zh: 三年，龍膊子山地道成，偕諸軍衝入城。

translations.literal: In the third year the tunnel at Longbozi Mountain was completed; together with the various armies he rushed into the city.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year the Longbozi tunnel was finished, and he stormed into the city with the other columns.

sentences.zh: 江寧平，以布政使記名，加頭品頂戴，予騎都尉世職。

translations.literal: When Jiangning was pacified, he was recorded by name as provincial administration commissioner, given the first-grade button, and granted the hereditary office of Cavalry Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: After Jiangning fell he was marked for provincial administration commissioner, given the first-grade button, and granted a hereditary Cavalry Commandant's post.

sentences.zh: 湘軍凱撤，曾國籓留連捷軍三千人駐守舒城、桐城防捻匪。

translations.literal: As the Hunan army returned in triumph, Zeng Guofan kept three thousand of Lianjie's troops to garrison Shucheng and Tongcheng against the Nian bandits.
translations.idiomatic: When the Hunan army marched home in victory, Guofan left three thousand of Lianjie's men to garrison Shucheng and Tongcheng against the Nian.

sentences.zh: 會霆營叛卒擾江西，連捷督軍追剿，駐防吉安、贛州，會剿粵匪餘黨於廣東嘉應州，盡殲之。

translations.literal: When rebel soldiers of the Ting Battalion disturbed Jiangxi, Lianjie directed troops in pursuit and suppression, garrisoned Ji'an and Ganzhou, and jointly suppressed Guangdong rebel remnants at Jiaying Prefecture in Guangdong, exterminating them all.
translations.idiomatic: When mutineers from the Ting Battalion raided Jiangxi, Lianjie led the pursuit, garrisoned Ji'an and Ganzhou, and joined the final campaign against Taiping holdouts at Jiaying in Guangdong, wiping them out.

sentences.zh: 連捷以傷病歸，家居十載。

translations.literal: Lianjie returned home for wounds and illness and lived at home for ten years.
translations.idiomatic: Wounds and illness sent Lianjie home, where he lived in retirement for ten years.

sentences.zh: 光緒中，曾國荃撫山西，奏起連捷練軍包頭，從國荃移屯山海關，又從至江南治江防。

translations.literal: During Guangxu, when Zeng Guoquan governed Shanxi, he memorialized to recall Lianjie to drill troops at Baotou; Lianjie followed Guoquan in transferring garrison to Shanhaiguan and then followed him to Jiangnan to manage river defenses.
translations.idiomatic: In the Guangxu era, when Guoquan became governor of Shanxi, he memorialized to recall Lianjie to drill troops at Baotou; Lianjie then followed him to Shanhaiguan and later to Jiangnan to oversee river defenses.

sentences.zh: 十三年，卒，賜卹，贈內閣學士，建專祠，諡勇介。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he died; condolence gifts were granted; he was posthumously given Grand Secretary of the Inner Court; a dedicated shrine was erected; the posthumous name Yongjie was given.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he died; the court granted posthumous honors, made him a grand secretary of the Inner Court in death, erected a dedicated shrine, and gave him the name Yongjie.

sentences.zh: =彭毓橘=彭毓橘，字杏南，湖南湘鄉人。

translations.literal: =Peng Yuju= Peng Yuju, styled Xingnan, was a native of Xiangxiang in Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: =Peng Yuju= Peng Yuju, whose style was Xingnan, came from Xiangxiang in Hunan.

sentences.zh: 從曾國荃援江西，積功敘縣丞。

translations.literal: Following Zeng Guoquan to relieve Jiangxi, he accumulated merit and was ranked as assistant county magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Guoquan into Jiangxi and earned enough merit to be ranked as assistant county magistrate.

sentences.zh: 及進安徽，小池驛、菱湖諸戰皆有功，又屢破援賊，累功擢知府。

translations.literal: When advancing into Anhui he distinguished himself at Xiaochi Post Station, Linghu, and other battles, repeatedly defeated relief rebels, and through cumulative merit was promoted to prefect.
translations.idiomatic: In the Anhui campaign he fought with distinction at Xiaochi Post Station and Linghu, broke rebel relief columns again and again, and rose to prefect on accumulated merit.

sentences.zh: 會諸軍下沿江諸要隘，渡江克太平府、金柱關、蕪湖，擢道員，賜號毅勇巴圖魯。

translations.literal: When the armies descended the Yangtze's key passes, crossed the river and took Taiping Prefecture, Jinzhu Pass, and Wuhu, he was promoted to circuit intendant and granted the title Yiyong Batulu.
translations.idiomatic: As the armies swept down the Yangtze strongholds and crossed the river to take Taiping, Jinzhu Pass, and Wuhu, he was made circuit intendant and given the title Yiyong Batulu.

sentences.zh: 大軍逼江寧，毓橘與諸將分路取丹陽鎮、秣陵關諸要隘，夷賊壘數十，進攻雨花台石城，賊死拒未下。

translations.literal: As the main army pressed Jiangning, Yuju with the various generals took separate routes to capture Zhenjiang, Moling Pass, and other key passes, leveled dozens of rebel forts, and advanced against the stone fortress at Yuhuatai; the rebels fought to the death and it was not taken.
translations.idiomatic: When the main force closed on Jiangning, Yuju and the other commanders took separate routes to seize Zhenjiang, Moling Pass, and other strongpoints, leveling dozens of rebel forts before assaulting the stone citadel at Yuhuatai, which the rebels held at all costs and would not yield.

sentences.zh: 李秀成率眾來援，大營被圍。

translations.literal: Li Xiucheng led masses to relieve the city, and the main camp was besieged.
translations.idiomatic: Li Xiucheng marched up with a large relief force, and the main camp was surrounded.

sentences.zh: 毓橘方染疫，力疾禦戰，伺懈出擊，破賊壘。

translations.literal: Yuju had just contracted plague; fighting illness he defended in battle, waited for slackness to sally, and broke rebel forts.
translations.idiomatic: Yuju had just fallen ill with plague but forced himself into the fight, waited for a lapse in the rebel line, sallied out, and smashed their forts.

sentences.zh: 解圍後，毓橘與劉連捷援江北，合水師連复江浦、和州、含山、巢縣四城，江北大定。

translations.literal: After the siege was lifted, Yuju and Liu Lianjie relieved the north bank; together with the naval force they in succession recovered the four cities of Jiangpu, Hezhou, Hanshan, and Chaoxian, and the north bank was settled.
translations.idiomatic: Once the siege was broken, Yuju and Liu Lianjie crossed to the north bank; with the river fleet they retook Jiangpu, Hezhou, Hanshan, and Chaoxian in turn, and the north bank was pacified.

sentences.zh: 削平江寧附近諸賊壘，毓橘功為多。

translations.literal: In leveling the rebel forts near Jiangning, Yuju's merit was greatest.
translations.idiomatic: In clearing the rebel fortifications around Jiangning, Yuju's contribution stood out above the rest.

sentences.zh: 龍膊子地道火發，督軍衝入，手刃退者。

translations.literal: When the Longbozi tunnel fire erupted, he directed troops to rush in and personally cut down those who retreated.
translations.idiomatic: When the Longbozi mine blew, he drove his men through the breach and personally killed any who turned back.

sentences.zh: 論功最，以布政使記名，予一等輕車都尉世職。

translations.literal: His merit was accounted greatest; he was recorded by name as provincial administration commissioner and granted a hereditary first-rank Commandant of Light Chariots.
translations.idiomatic: Ranked first in merit, he was marked for provincial administration commissioner and given a hereditary first-rank Commandant of Light Chariots.

sentences.zh: 尋授福建汀漳龍兵備道，未之任，曾國荃疏調毓橘統湘軍赴湖北，捻匪竄擾黃州、安陸，毓橘進剿，戰比有功。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he was appointed Fujian Ting-Zhang-Long circuit military intendant; before taking office, Zeng Guoquan memorialized to transfer Yuju to command Hunan troops to Hubei; Nian bandits raided Huangzhou and Anlu; Yuju advanced to suppress them and fought with merit in successive engagements.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon appointed military intendant of the Ting-Zhang-Long circuit in Fujian, but before he could take up the post Guoquan memorialized to send him to Hubei at the head of Hunan troops; when Nian raiders struck Huangzhou and Anlu, Yuju marched against them and won merit in fight after fight.

sentences.zh: 同治六年，師次蘄水，毓橘率小隊數百，週覽地勢，至麒麟凹，賊大至，被圍，搏戰，死傷略盡。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Tongzhi the army halted at Qishui; Yuju led a small party of several hundred to survey the terrain and reached Qilin'ao; rebels came in force, they were surrounded, fought hand to hand, and the dead and wounded were nearly all.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Tongzhi the army camped at Qishui; Yuju took a few hundred men to reconnoiter and reached Qilin'ao, where a large rebel force fell upon them; surrounded, they fought to the last and nearly all were killed or wounded.

sentences.zh: 毓橘馬陷泥淖，被執，{罒馬}賊被害。

translations.literal: Yuju's horse sank in the mud; he was captured, reviled the rebels, and was killed.
translations.idiomatic: Yuju's horse mired in the mud; he was taken prisoner, reviled the rebels, and was put to death.

sentences.zh: 事聞，詔視布政使陣亡例議卹，建專祠，贈內閣學士，諡忠壯，加騎都尉世職，並為三等男爵。

translations.literal: When the matter was reported, an edict ordered condolence deliberated according to the regulation for a provincial administration commissioner killed in battle; a dedicated shrine was erected; he was posthumously given Grand Secretary of the Inner Court; the posthumous name Zhongzhuang was given; the hereditary office of Cavalry Commandant was added, and he was also made a third-rank baron.
translations.idiomatic: When word reached the court, an edict directed posthumous honors under the rule for a provincial administration commissioner killed in action, ordered a dedicated shrine, made him a grand secretary of the Inner Court in death, gave him the name Zhongzhuang, added a hereditary Cavalry Commandant's post, and ennobled him as a third-rank baron.

sentences.zh: =張詩日=張詩日，湖南湘鄉人。

translations.literal: =Zhang Shiri= Zhang Shiri was a native of Xiangxiang in Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: =Zhang Shiri= Zhang Shiri came from Xiangxiang in Hunan.

sentences.zh: 咸豐五年，以外委隨羅澤南戰江西，克義寧。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Xianfeng, as an externe corporal he followed Luo Zinan to fight in Jiangxi and took Yining.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Xianfeng he served as an externe corporal under Luo Zinan in Jiangxi and helped take Yining.

sentences.zh: 六年，改隸曾國荃軍，克安福，戰吉安。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he was transferred to Zeng Guoquan's army, took Anfu, and fought at Ji'an.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he passed to Guoquan's command, captured Anfu, and fought at Ji'an.

sentences.zh: 八年，复萬安、吉水，超擢守備。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he again took Wan'an and Jishui and was exceptionally promoted to garrison commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he retook Wan'an and Jishui and was jumped to garrison commander.

sentences.zh: 九年，以克吉安及景德鎮、浮梁，累擢游擊。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, for taking Ji'an as well as Jingdezhen and Fuliang, he was promoted in succession to battalion commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, for the capture of Ji'an, Jingdezhen, and Fuliang, he rose to battalion commander.

sentences.zh: 十年，援小池驛，复太湖、潛山，晉參將。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he relieved Xiaochi Post Station and again took Taihu and Qianshan, and was promoted to deputy commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he relieved Xiaochi Post Station, retook Taihu and Qianshan, and was made deputy commander.

sentences.zh: 從攻安慶，率三營破援賊於樅陽。

translations.literal: Joining the attack on Anqing, he led three battalions to defeat relief rebels at Zongyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the Anqing campaign he led three battalions and routed the relief rebels at Zongyang.

sentences.zh: 十一年，克安慶，擢副將，加總兵銜，賜號幹勇巴圖魯。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year Anqing was taken; he was promoted to brigade commander, given the brevet rank of regional commander, and granted the title Ganyong Batulu.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year Anqing fell; he was made brigade commander with brevet rank as regional commander and received the title Ganyong Batulu.

sentences.zh: 同治元年，從克沿江要隘。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tongzhi he followed in taking the Yangtze's fortified passes.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tongzhi he helped capture the Yangtze strongholds one after another.

sentences.zh: 及抵江寧，力守大營，破援賊。

translations.literal: When he reached Jiangning, he staunchly defended the main camp and defeated relief rebels.
translations.idiomatic: On reaching Jiangning he held the main camp with all his strength and broke the rebel relief columns.

sentences.zh: 累擢，以提督記名。

translations.literal: Through repeated promotions he was recorded by name as provincial commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Further promotions marked him for provincial commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 二年，屢破江寧城外賊壘，賜黃馬褂。

translations.literal: In the second year he repeatedly broke rebel forts outside Jiangning and was granted a yellow riding jacket.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he smashed rebel fortifications outside Jiangning again and again and was awarded a yellow riding jacket.

sentences.zh: 三年，克天保、地保兩城。

translations.literal: In the third year he took the two fortresses Tianbao and Dibao.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he captured the twin forts of Tianbao and Dibao.

sentences.zh: 方開掘龍膊子地道，李秀成夜自太平門突出來犯，又詐為官軍，別從朝陽門東隅出，偪營縱火，詩日偕諸將力戰卻之。

translations.literal: Just as the Longbozi tunnel was being dug, Li Xiucheng by night sallied from Taiping Gate to attack; he also disguised his men as government troops and separately came out from the east corner of Chaoyang Gate, pressing the camp and setting fire; Shiri with the generals fought fiercely and repulsed them.
translations.idiomatic: While the Longbozi tunnel was still being dug, Li Xiucheng burst out of Taiping Gate by night; he also sent men disguised as imperial troops from the east side of Chaoyang Gate to press the camp and set it ablaze, but Shiri and the other commanders fought them off.

sentences.zh: 地道火發，城崩，詩日率士卒登龍廣山，奪太平門；

translations.literal: The tunnel fire erupted and the wall collapsed; Shiri led soldiers up Longguang Hill and took Taiping Gate;
translations.idiomatic: When the mine detonated and the wall gave way, Shiri led his men up Longguang Hill and seized Taiping Gate;

sentences.zh: 复循神策門轉戰至獅子山，奪儀鳳門。

translations.literal: then fought along Shence Gate to Shizi Hill and took Yifeng Gate.
translations.idiomatic: then fought his way from Shence Gate to Shizi Hill and took Yifeng Gate.

sentences.zh: 論功最，予一等輕車都尉世職。

translations.literal: His merit was accounted greatest, and he was granted a hereditary first-rank Commandant of Light Chariots.
translations.idiomatic: Ranked first in merit, he received a hereditary first-rank Commandant of Light Chariots.

sentences.zh: 四年，授直隸宣化鎮總兵。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he was appointed regional commander of Xuanhua Garrison in Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he was made regional commander of the Xuanhua garrison in Zhili.

sentences.zh: 五年，從曾國籓剿捻，破張總愚、牛洛紅於西平，又敗之萬金寨，進攻雙廟賊巢。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he followed Zeng Guofan against the Nian, defeated Zhang Zongyu and Niu Luohong at Xiping, again defeated them at Wanjinzhai, and advanced against the rebel nest at Shuangmiao.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he followed Guofan against the Nian, routed Zhang Zongyu and Niu Luohong at Xiping, beat them again at Wanjinzhai, and pushed on against the rebel stronghold at Shuangmiao.

sentences.zh: 賊以馬隊襲官軍後，詩日分軍回擊，追敗之洪河，又敗之郾城、召陵。

translations.literal: The rebels with cavalry attacked the rear of the government army; Shiri divided his force to counterattack, pursued and defeated them at Honghe, and again defeated them at Yancheng and Shaoling.
translations.idiomatic: When rebel horsemen struck the imperial rear, Shiri split his force to counter, chased them down at Honghe, and routed them again at Yancheng and Shaoling.

sentences.zh: 因傷發回籍，六年，卒。

translations.literal: Because his wounds flared up he returned home; in the sixth year he died.
translations.idiomatic: Old wounds reopened and he went home; he died in the sixth year.

sentences.zh: 曾國籓疏陳詩日克復江寧，當西北一路，論功在李臣典、劉連捷、蕭孚泗之次，優恤，諡勤武。

translations.literal: Zeng Guofan in a memorial reported that Shiri in recovering Jiangning held the northwest route; in accounting merit he ranked after Li Chendian, Liu Lianjie, and Xiao Fusi; generous posthumous honors were granted, and the posthumous name Qinwu was given.
translations.idiomatic: Guofan memorialized that in the recovery of Jiangning Shiri had held the northwest sector, ranking in merit after Li Chendian, Liu Lianjie, and Xiao Fusi; the court granted generous posthumous honors and the name Qinwu.

sentences.zh: =伍維壽=伍維壽，湖南長沙人。

translations.literal: =Wu Weishou= Wu Weishou was a native of Changsha in Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: =Wu Weishou= Wu Weishou came from Changsha in Hunan.

sentences.zh: 從曾國荃援江西，攻安慶，克沿江要隘，擢副將。

translations.literal: Following Zeng Guoquan to relieve Jiangxi, he attacked Anqing, took key passes along the Yangtze, and was promoted to brigade commander.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Guoquan into Jiangxi, fought at Anqing, captured Yangtze strongholds, and was made brigade commander.

sentences.zh: 奪雨花台、聚寶門外石壘，累擢記名總兵，賜號毅勇巴圖魯。

translations.literal: He seized the stone forts outside Yuhuatai and the Gate of Gathering Treasure, was repeatedly promoted and recorded by name as regional commander, and was granted the title Yiyong Batulu.
translations.idiomatic: He took the stone forts at Yuhuatai and outside the Gate of Gathering Treasure, rose to nomination as regional commander, and received the title Yiyong Batulu.

sentences.zh: 偕朱南桂破神策門，入城，率馬隊追逸賊至湖熟鎮，擒斬賊酋李萬材等，以提督記名，賜黃馬褂，予騎都尉世職。

translations.literal: Together with Zhu Nangui he broke Shence Gate and entered the city; he led the cavalry in pursuit of fleeing rebels to Hushu Town, captured and beheaded the rebel chieftain Li Wancai and others, was recorded by name as provincial commander-in-chief, was granted a yellow riding jacket, and was given the hereditary office of Cavalry Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: With Zhu Nangui he breached Shence Gate and entered the city, then led the cavalry in pursuit to Hushu Town, where he captured and executed the rebel chief Li Wancai and others; he was marked for provincial commander-in-chief, awarded a yellow riding jacket, and granted a hereditary Cavalry Commandant's post.

sentences.zh: 六年，授陝西漢中鎮總兵，調甘肅寧夏鎮，光緒元年，卒。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he was appointed regional commander of Hanzhong Garrison in Shaanxi, transferred to Ningxia Garrison in Gansu, and in the first year of Guangxu he died.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he was made regional commander of Hanzhong in Shaanxi, then transferred to Ningxia in Gansu; he died in the first year of Guangxu.

sentences.zh: =朱南桂=朱南桂，湖南長沙人。

translations.literal: =Zhu Nangui= Zhu Nangui was a native of Changsha in Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: =Zhu Nangui= Zhu Nangui came from Changsha in Hunan.

sentences.zh: 羅澤南舊部，轉戰兩湖，積功至副將，賜號勗勇巴圖魯。

translations.literal: An old subordinate of Luo Zinan, he campaigned in the Two Hu and through accumulated merit reached brigade commander and was granted the title Xuyong Batulu.
translations.idiomatic: A veteran of Luo Zinan's command, he fought across Hunan and Hubei, rose to brigade commander on accumulated merit, and received the title Xuyong Batulu.

sentences.zh: 同治元年，解金柱關圍。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tongzhi he lifted the siege at Jinzhu Pass.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tongzhi he broke the siege at Jinzhu Pass.

sentences.zh: 二年，克薛鎮、博望鎮，以總兵記名。

translations.literal: In the second year he took Xue Town and Bowang Town and was recorded by name as regional commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he captured Xue Town and Bowang Town and was marked for regional commander.

sentences.zh: 及克江寧，南桂先破神策門月城，梯而入，賜黃馬褂，予雲騎尉世職。

translations.literal: When Jiangning was taken, Nangui first broke the outer ward of Shence Gate and entered by scaling ladders; he was granted a yellow riding jacket and given the hereditary office of Cloud Cavalry Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: In the fall of Jiangning, Nangui was first over the outer ward of Shence Gate, scaling the wall on ladders; he received a yellow riding jacket and a hereditary Cloud Cavalry Commandant's post.

sentences.zh: 尋授河南歸德鎮總兵。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he was appointed regional commander of Guide Garrison in Henan.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon appointed regional commander of the Guide garrison in Henan.

sentences.zh: 五年卒，賜卹，諡勤勇。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he died; condolence gifts were granted, and the posthumous name Qinyong was given.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the fifth year; the court granted posthumous honors and the name Qinyong.

sentences.zh: =羅逢元=羅逢元，湖南湘潭人。

translations.literal: =Luo Fengyuan= Luo Fengyuan was a native of Xiangtan in Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: =Luo Fengyuan= Luo Fengyuan came from Xiangtan in Hunan.

sentences.zh: 由武生入伍，從剿廣西。

translations.literal: From military licentiate he entered the ranks and followed the suppression campaign in Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: A military licentiate, he enlisted and fought in the Guangxi campaign.

sentences.zh: 曾國籓治水師，充營官，轉戰湖北、江西，累擢副將。

translations.literal: When Zeng Guofan organized the naval force, he served as battalion officer, campaigned in Hubei and Jiangxi, and through repeated promotions reached brigade commander.
translations.idiomatic: When Guofan built the river fleet, Fengyuan served as battalion officer, fought through Hubei and Jiangxi, and rose to brigade commander.

sentences.zh: 繼從曾國荃克安慶，以總兵記名，賜號展勇巴圖魯。

translations.literal: He then followed Zeng Guoquan in taking Anqing, was recorded by name as regional commander, and was granted the title Zhanyong Batulu.
translations.idiomatic: He then followed Guoquan in the capture of Anqing, was marked for regional commander, and received the title Zhanyong Batulu.

sentences.zh: 進克沿江要隘，抵江寧，還守太平，屯金柱關。

translations.literal: Advancing he took key passes along the Yangtze, reached Jiangning, returned to defend Taiping, and encamped at Jinzhu Pass.
translations.idiomatic: He pushed on to capture Yangtze strongholds, reached Jiangning, then fell back to hold Taiping and camp at Jinzhu Pass.

sentences.zh: 賊酋陳坤書大舉來犯，逢元堅守，屢戰，以少擊眾，擒斬逾萬，以提督記名。

translations.literal: The rebel chieftain Chen Kunshu came in force to attack; Fengyuan defended staunchly, fought repeatedly, struck many with few, captured and beheaded more than ten thousand, and was recorded by name as provincial commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: When the rebel chief Chen Kunshu attacked in strength, Fengyuan held firm through battle after battle, repeatedly beating larger forces and killing more than ten thousand; he was marked for provincial commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 及克江寧，由南門舊陷口梯登，賜黃馬褂，予雲騎尉世職。

translations.literal: When Jiangning was taken, he scaled the wall by ladder through the old breach at the south gate; he was granted a yellow riding jacket and given the hereditary office of Cloud Cavalry Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: When Jiangning fell he went up by ladder through the old breach at the south gate, and received a yellow riding jacket and a hereditary Cloud Cavalry Commandant's post.

sentences.zh: 以傷發假歸，光緒四年，卒，賜卹。

translations.literal: Because his wounds flared up he took leave and returned home; in the fourth year of Guangxu he died, and condolence gifts were granted.
translations.idiomatic: Old wounds forced him home on leave; he died in the fourth year of Guangxu, and the court granted posthumous honors.

sentences.zh: =李祥和=李祥和，湖南湘鄉人。

translations.literal: =Li Xianghe= Li Xianghe was a native of Xiangxiang in Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: =Li Xianghe= Li Xianghe came from Xiangxiang in Hunan.

sentences.zh: 初從羅澤南，積功至游擊。

translations.literal: At first he followed Luo Zinan and through accumulated merit reached battalion commander.
translations.idiomatic: He began under Luo Zinan and rose to battalion commander on accumulated merit.

sentences.zh: 嗣從曾國荃，克吉安，復安慶，累擢副將，賜號著勇巴圖魯。

translations.literal: He then followed Zeng Guoquan, took Ji'an, again took Anqing, was promoted in succession to brigade commander, and was granted the title Zhuyong Batulu.
translations.idiomatic: He then served under Guoquan, captured Ji'an and Anqing, rose to brigade commander, and received the title Zhuyong Batulu.

sentences.zh: 同治元年，從大軍進江寧，力守大營，破援賊，以提督記名。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tongzhi he followed the main army into Jiangning, staunchly defended the main camp, defeated relief rebels, and was recorded by name as provincial commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tongzhi he marched on Jiangning with the main force, held the main camp with all his strength, broke the rebel relief columns, and was marked for provincial commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 三年，攻克地保城，先登，築砲台俯擊城中，地道始成。

translations.literal: In the third year he stormed and took Dibao Fortress, was first to scale the wall, built batteries to fire down into the city, and only then was the tunnel completed.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he led the assault on Dibao Fortress, was first over the wall, erected batteries to rake the city from above, and thereby made the tunnel work possible.

sentences.zh: 論功，賜黃馬褂，予雲騎尉世職。

translations.literal: In accounting merit he was granted a yellow riding jacket and given the hereditary office of Cloud Cavalry Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: For his service he received a yellow riding jacket and a hereditary Cloud Cavalry Commandant's post.

sentences.zh: 四年，授安徽壽春鎮總兵，從劉松山赴陝西剿捻匪。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he was appointed regional commander of Shouchun Garrison in Anhui and followed Liu Songshan to Shaanxi to suppress Nian bandits.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he was made regional commander of Shouchun in Anhui and followed Liu Songshan into Shaanxi against the Nian.

sentences.zh: 六年，戰洛川大賢村，中砲陣亡，賜卹，諡武壯。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he fought at Daxian Village in Luochuan, was killed by cannon, and condolence gifts were granted; the posthumous name Wuzhuang was given.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he fought at Daxian Village in Luochuan, was killed by cannon fire, and the court granted posthumous honors and the name Wuzhuang.

sentences.zh: =蕭慶衍=蕭慶衍，湖南湘鄉人。

translations.literal: =Xiao Qingyan= Xiao Qingyan was a native of Xiangxiang in Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: =Xiao Qingyan= Xiao Qingyan came from Xiangxiang in Hunan.

sentences.zh: 應募入湘軍右營，轉戰江西、湖北，積功至副將。

translations.literal: He enlisted in the Right Battalion of the Hunan Army, campaigned in Jiangxi and Hubei, and through accumulated merit reached brigade commander.
translations.idiomatic: He joined the Hunan Army's Right Battalion, fought through Jiangxi and Hubei, and rose to brigade commander.

sentences.zh: 克太湖、潛山，以總兵記名，賜號剛勇巴圖魯。

translations.literal: He took Taihu and Qianshan, was recorded by name as regional commander, and was granted the title Gangyong Batulu.
translations.idiomatic: After capturing Taihu and Qianshan he was marked for regional commander and given the title Gangyong Batulu.

sentences.zh: 同治二年，援江浦，复含山、巢縣、和州，加頭品頂戴。

translations.literal: In the second year of Tongzhi he relieved Jiangpu and again took Hanshan, Chaoxian, and Hezhou, and was given the first-grade button.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Tongzhi he relieved Jiangpu and retook Hanshan, Chaoxian, and Hezhou, earning the first-grade button.

sentences.zh: 三年，渡江會攻江寧，克上方橋，進鍾山，築三壘太平門外。

translations.literal: In the third year he crossed the river to join the attack on Jiangning, took Shangfang Bridge, advanced to Zhong Hill, and built three forts outside Taiping Gate.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he crossed the Yangtze to join the siege of Jiangning, took Shangfang Bridge, pushed up Zhong Hill, and raised three forts outside Taiping Gate.

sentences.zh: 城破，於缺口衝入，奪朝陽、洪武二門，賜黃馬褂，予雲騎尉世職。

translations.literal: When the city fell he rushed in through the breach, took Chaoyang and Hongwu Gates, was granted a yellow riding jacket, and was given the hereditary office of Cloud Cavalry Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: When the wall gave way he charged through the breach, seized Chaoyang and Hongwu Gates, and received a yellow riding jacket and a hereditary Cloud Cavalry Commandant's post.

sentences.zh: =吳宗國=吳宗國，湖南長沙人。

translations.literal: =Wu Zongguo= Wu Zongguo was a native of Changsha in Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: =Wu Zongguo= Wu Zongguo came from Changsha in Hunan.

sentences.zh: 以勇目從剿湖北，累擢守備。

translations.literal: As an enlisted brave he followed the suppression campaign in Hubei and through repeated promotions reached garrison commander.
translations.idiomatic: Enlisting as a militia private, he fought in Hubei and rose to garrison commander.

sentences.zh: 同治元年，從曾國荃沿江東下，迭克要隘，​​功多，累擢參將，賜號資勇巴圖魯。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tongzhi he followed Zeng Guoquan eastward down the Yangtze, in succession took key passes, his merit was great, he was promoted in succession to deputy commander, and was granted the title Ziyong Batulu.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tongzhi he followed Guoquan down the Yangtze, capturing one stronghold after another with outstanding merit, rose to deputy commander, and received the title Ziyong Batulu.

sentences.zh: 二年，破聚寶門外上方橋、江東橋各賊壘，會水師破九洑洲、印子山賊巢，擢副將。

translations.literal: In the second year he broke the rebel forts at Shangfang Bridge and Jiangdong Bridge outside the Gate of Gathering Treasure, and together with the naval force broke the rebel nests at Jiufuzhou and Yinzi Hill; he was promoted to brigade commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he smashed the rebel forts at Shangfang Bridge and Jiangdong Bridge outside the Gate of Gathering Treasure, joined the river fleet in taking Jiufuzhou and Yinzi Hill, and was made brigade commander.

sentences.zh: 從李臣典重開地道，城賊防益嚴，砲彈雨下。

translations.literal: Following Li Chendian in reopening the tunnel, the city rebels' defenses grew ever stricter and cannonballs rained down.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Li Chendian in reopening the tunnel while the rebels inside tightened their defenses and cannon fire poured down like rain.

sentences.zh: 宗國手藤牌，持長繩，冒砲彈，狙行而前，抵城下測丈而返，始興工開掘。

translations.literal: Zongguo with rattan shield in hand and a long rope, braving cannon shot, crept forward; reaching beneath the wall he measured and returned, and only then was work begun on the tunnel.
translations.idiomatic: Zongguo took a rattan shield and a long rope, ran the gauntlet of cannon fire, and crawled forward to measure under the wall before returning; only then did the mining begin in earnest.

sentences.zh: 大功克成，以提督記名，予一品封典。

translations.literal: When the great achievement was accomplished, he was recorded by name as provincial commander-in-chief and granted a first-rank enfeoffment patent.
translations.idiomatic: When the city fell he was nominated provincial commander-in-chief and granted a first-rank patent of enfeoffment.

sentences.zh: 五年，偕提督郭松林剿捻德安，戰羅家集，中伏，歿於陣，依提督例賜卹，予騎都尉世職。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, together with provincial commander-in-chief Guo Songlin he suppressed the Nian rebels at De’an; fighting at Luojiaji he fell into an ambush and died in battle; condolence gifts were granted according to the regulations for a fallen provincial commander, and he was given the hereditary office of Cavalry Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he joined Provincial Commander Guo Songlin against the Nian at De’an; at Luojiaji he walked into an ambush and died on the field; the court mourned him at provincial-commander rank and granted a hereditary Cavalry Commandant title.

sentences.zh: =【論】=論曰：洪秀全踞江寧十有餘年，曾國荃於蘇、浙未定之先，孤軍直搗，城大援眾，事勢綦難。

translations.literal: =【Commentary】= The commentary says: Hong Xiuquan held Jiangning for more than ten years; before Jiangsu and Zhejiang were settled, Zeng Guoquan with a lone army drove straight in—the city was large, relief forces numerous, and the situation extremely difficult.
translations.idiomatic: =【Commentary】= The historians remark: Hong Xiuquan had held Jiangning for more than a decade when Guoquan, before Jiangsu and Zhejiang were pacified, struck in with a single army—a vast city, massive relief, and odds as hard as they come.

sentences.zh: 及援賊既破，困獸之鬥，人人致死，歷兩年之久，竟蕆大功。

translations.literal: When the relief rebels had been broken, it was the fight of a cornered beast—every man fought to the death; over two years the great achievement was at last completed.
translations.idiomatic: Once the relief columns were shattered, the defenders fought like trapped beasts, every man ready to die; after two grinding years the great victory was finally won.

sentences.zh: 固由指揮素定，而在事諸將，同心效力，奮不顧身，其勇毅之烈，紀太常而光紫閣，無愧色焉。

translations.literal: It was indeed because command had long been settled, but the generals in the affair exerted themselves with one heart, daring their lives without regard; their fierce courage is recorded in the Temple of Eminent Merit and shines in the Zige Pavilion—without any cause for shame.
translations.idiomatic: No doubt steady command mattered, but the generals on the ground fought as one, reckless of their lives; their valor belongs in the rolls of the Temple of Eminent Merit and the glory of the Zige Pavilion, and they need not blush beside either.

sentences.zh: 掇其尤者著於篇。

translations.literal: The most outstanding among them are gathered and set down in this chapter.
translations.idiomatic: The foremost of them are gathered here in this chapter.
